first_missing_criterion: Public OS NGD Building sample service was identified as the materially changed official source family, but the ArcGIS query endpoint is not retrievable through the current web retrieval channel; no feature payload can therefore be verified. No synthetic records are created and no building footprint/use is accepted without record-level evidence.
official_source_basis: Ordnance Survey OS NGD Sample Data documentation states that free Building Features sample data cover Exeter and use the latest schema; OS NGD Building Feature Type documentation states the Building geometry is a single building footprint and buildinguse describes what the building is used for.
